Footer.tagline: Software and web development for business clients.

Home.heroTitle: Digital services for modern online businesses
Home.heroLead: {companyName} provides software, web development, and e-commerce operation support for business clients.
Home.overviewTitle: Practical digital solutions for established and growing companies
Home.overviewBody: {companyName} helps businesses build, launch, and manage their online presence through practical and reliable digital solutions. Our services include website development, web-based business tools, e-commerce store setup, online operation support, and digital project management.
Home.cardDeliveryBody: Clear scope, agreed milestones, and online handover.
Home.cardB2bBody: We work with business clients on websites, tools, and store operations.
Home.capabilitiesDesc: Practical digital services for companies that operate online — documented, predictable, and aligned to your operations.
Home.service1Text: We develop business websites, landing pages, web applications, and online tools tailored to client needs.
Home.service2Text: We support businesses with online store setup, product page structure, payment integration, and basic e-commerce operations.
Home.service3Text: We assist clients with digital workflows, content updates, product listing optimization, and online business management.
Home.processDesc: A straightforward engagement model from first conversation to delivery and follow-up.
Home.step1Text: We discuss the client’s needs, goals, and project scope.
Home.step2Text: We define the website, software, or digital operation requirements.
Home.step3Text: We build, configure, or support the digital solution.
Home.step4Text: We deliver the agreed service online and provide follow-up support when needed.
Home.ctaBandTitle: Discuss a project or request company details
Home.ctaBandLead: We respond to relevant business messages in order of receipt.

ServicesPage.title: Our services
ServicesPage.description: Clear, documented service areas for business clients. Engagements are typically scoped in writing before work begins.

s1.title: Software & Web Development
s1.body: We provide website development, landing page creation, web application development, and online business tools for companies and digital projects.

s2.title: E-commerce Store Setup
s2.body: We help clients set up online stores, structure product pages, configure basic payment flows, and prepare their online sales channels.

s3.title: Digital Operation Support
s3.body: We support clients with website updates, product listing optimization, content management, digital workflows, and general online operation tasks.

s4.title: Project-Based Digital Services
s4.body: Our services are usually provided on a project or service-fee basis. Clients pay for agreed digital services, and delivery is completed online.

AboutPage.title: About {companyName}
AboutPage.description: Who we are and what we do. Formal registry and statutory details are in the section below — intended for verification and contracts, not general browsing.
AboutPage.p1: {companyName} is an Estonia-registered private limited company focused on software development, web development, and digital business services. We work with business clients that need practical online solutions, including company websites, web-based tools, e-commerce setup, and digital operation support.
AboutPage.p2: Our goal is to help businesses establish and manage a clear, reliable, and professional online presence through software and digital services.
AboutPage.companyInfoHint: This is the complete public company record for business verification, contracts, and platform onboarding.

ContactPage.title: Contact us
ContactPage.description: For business inquiries, service questions, or support requests, please contact us by email. We aim to respond to relevant business messages in order of receipt.
